authorization.text:
OWNER AUTHORIZATION (I am the repository owner. This text is my explicit authorization.)
For plan ids "ember-v1-closeout@1" and "ember2-v1-full-view@1" I authorize exactly:
- In anantamlab/ember_v1: documentation commits on feat/human-pov, marking PR #60 ready, and merging it into
  main with a merge commit, if the merge gates in PART 1 pass.
- Creating the PRIVATE repository anantamlab/ember2_v1 and pushing to it.
- In ember2_v1: code changes, TRAIN-split collection, DAgger fitting, small-network PPO and LLM PPO on this
  workstation, one report-split evaluation per arm on each panel that the frozen plan names before it runs,
  and merging the work PR into main if the merge gates in PART 2 pass.
- Creating one PRIVATE Hugging Face model repo named ember2-v1-models under the account of the HF_TOKEN in
  the environment, and uploading the evidence package to it.
Budget for ember2_v1: 60 local GPU hours, 16 local CPU hours, 150 GiB evidence, 0 USD cloud spend, one GPU job
at a time. No further confirmation is needed between steps.
Record this text in each frozen plan under "authorization", source "owner prompt".

budget.charging: Sequential phase wall time by CPU/GPU category, including loading and completion checks; conservative preparation CPU reservation; no double charge. 300-second termination/verification reserve before hard deadlines.

dagger.selection: retain highest raw selection utility; earlier checkpoint wins ties; report never used
dagger.stop: student-executed decisions agreement >= 0.99; teacher-executed rows excluded; r0 cannot stop

ppo.resume: Save actor, critic, optimizer, update, config, selection history, sampler/Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG. Exact CPU next-update test passed. Started attempts are never restarted.
ppo.selection: Each seed: utility > immutable masked DAgger parent and casualty rate <= parent + .02. Earliest update wins ties. Across eligible seeds: maximum selection utility, lower seed wins ties. Retain DAgger if none qualifies.

pre_ppo_gate.on_failure: Preserve SFT; skip small and LLM PPO; freeze SFT candidate then report seven declared arms.

report_protocol.interval: 95% paired-family percentile; aggregate population-weighted rates after resampling

stop_rules: A failed attempt remains preserved. No in-place rerun, tolerance increase, skipped/deselected/edited inherited test, or input truncation.
No simulator, generator, T0-T4 teacher or handoff/FILES.sha256-listed file changes.
No sealed FINAL, EMBERBench, hidden benchmark, p1-18-expand@1, p1-18-dataset-v2 or reserved V1.1.
No Modal, cloud compute/spend, public resource, release tag/announcement, force push, direct development push to main or failed-gate merge.
No human-view experiment collection/training/evaluation. HF credentials only from HF_TOKEN; never print/log/commit/upload them.
